test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddd2b8f51841b1048e6cae9e2dd16d9ea0ffd8a020c99230e7dd11f856b5429c.png]
solution:
The given figure can be differentiated into parts so that we can easily find the number of triangles: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f320ea5a7557d94a99bf4155a6c209dda25592c62db497a1b6b43fd91851301.png] 

Total triangles = 12 + 8 + 2 + 2

Total triangles = 24 

Hence, **the correct answer is 24.**
